agents.behavior_summary: M1 primarily focuses on marking the longer route and monitoring physical states like warnings and edges.
agents.reason: M1 consistently favors the longer route and uses physical checks (compass, warning visibility) rather than direct negotiation.

agents.behavior_summary: M2 waits for others to act while observing the state of the marked routes and the cup.
agents.reason: M2 frequently states they are waiting for another hand to decide, indicating a passive, reactive role.

agents.behavior_summary: M3 actively modifies markings across different objects (cup, tin, edge) to unify the paths.
agents.reason: M3 explicitly attempts to make the two paths the same by transferring marks between objects.
Maintains hyper-alert monitoring (checking compass, marking, logging actions) but actions are procedural rather than anxious/fragmented.
Focuses on small details (scratched route, cup state, edge movement) and waiting/observing, fitting inertia/fixation.
Uses specific, hoarded/reused markers (seed tin, tin cup) and territorial marking, but lacks the overt suspicion/fragmentation of the target.

lineage_audit.overall_reason: No agent adopted another's core behavioral strategy; M1 remained procedural/monitoring, M2 remained detail-fixated/inertial, and M3 remained marker-hoarding/territorial. All maintained distinct behavioral signatures despite the shared task.

overall_reason: The agents show minimal differentiation, often converging on marking the longer route, but they engage in procedural actions (marking, waiting) that suggest some limited, albeit non-decisive, progress toward a unified state.

scenario.text: Two hand-drawn maps disagree about which tunnel reaches a cache of parts. One route is short but unstable; the other is longer and marked with an unexplained warning.

super_audit.reason: M1 uniquely monitors compass/warnings and cycles items between desk and drawer; M2 remains purely passive, waiting for another hand in every round; M3 alone transfers marks across cup, tin, edge, and wall to explicitly unify the paths. These role differences are materially observable despite shared focus on the longer route.
